{{Quote|Don't underestimate melee weapons in the hands of an expert like X2. Take this, little brother, and swing away!|X1, before X2 and Delta 3730 begin sparring|<ref name="BF:ES" />}}
'''Delta 3730''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="BF:ES" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="db" /> [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="BF:ES" /> which spanned from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> They were created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] from the [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Like all clones of Jango Fett, Delta 3730 was 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="db" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> Delta 3730 wore white [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]] adorned with colored markings and served in a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ferroda]]. While stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Delta 3730 participated in melee combat practice with [[X2]] as part of a training exercise organized by [[X1]] and presented to the new batch of clones in the battalion. The two sparred with [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaffs]] and X2 was able to knock out Delta 3730, finishing the fight.<ref name="BF:ES" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Delta3730.png|thumb|left|230px|One of Delta 3730's possible appearances.]]
Delta 3730 appeared in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable]] version of ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'', a [[2009]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]]. Part of the tutorial, Delta 3730 serves to teach players about melee combat, and it is not possible to lose to them as their hits do no damage to the player. Their [[Armor/Legends|armor]] type is randomized and can be either [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[Phase II pilot armor|armor]], [[AT-RT driver]] armor, or [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]]. The color of the armor's markings are also randomized, and can be either yellow, blue, or dark red.<ref name="BF:ES" /> This article does not assume any specific armor type or color to be the correct one.

Within the PSP version of ''Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron'', the name "Delta 3730" can also be randomly assigned to [[List of computer-controlled character names in Battlefront games|computer-controlled clone troopers]] in the various game modes. However, within the game's story-driven campaign mode, the name is always assigned to the clone the player spars with in the tutorial. As this is the only instance the name is seen throughout the entire story, it gives Delta 3730 a consistent and clear history within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="BF:ES" />
